items.quarantine_reason: Key check 2 retry (19 Oct 2026, P15listens1 + P15listens2, reconciler P15listens2): P15listens1 chose Vargas, the key is Varga. P15listens2 chose Varga from the audio: in clip ieli01-r5 (about 11.6-13.7 s) the parent says "Leo Varga" (no s), then spells V-A-R-G-A, and nothing follows the A until the next turn (no S). P15listens1 heard "Leo Vargas, V-A-R-G-A-S": the scripted "Varga is" is spoken so fast that it sounds like "Vargas" (one of P15listens2's two Whisper models also wrote "Vargas" there). The first pass (18 Oct) had both solvers on Varga; one of two solvers now disagrees, so it is quarantined. Re-render the line so it cannot be heard as Vargas (e.g. "That's V-A-R-G-A"), then a new blind check.; v2 (agent:p16-content, 19 Oct 2026): answered from a new clip of its own, ieli01-r7 (Greenway Tennis Club, Receptionist British bm_lewis, Caller American af_sarah; Kokoro-82M in D:/tools/tts/venv, render_nosplit.py, speed 0.95, as the unit 1 Part 1 clips), so ieli01-r5 and its six verified items keep their audio and their checks; the name is said ("Grace Malloy."), the other voice asks for the spelling, and it is spelled in a turn of its own ("Of course. It's M-A-double L-O-Y.") and repeated by the receptionist; faster-whisper small.en, large-v3 and large-v3-turbo hear M-A-L-L-O-Y (or M-A-double-L-O-Y) in all 36 decodes of the spelling stretches (plain and prompted, at 1.0 and atempo 0.6) and the caller's spelling so in all 4 whole-clip decodes, where large-v3-turbo once wrote the receptionist's repeat as M-A-L-L-L-O-Y; the clip's WER 0.0 % (small.en, large-v3); new stem, key (Malloy) and why; subskill, level, word limit, instructions, prior_b and time_s as in v1

stem.en:
WESTBROOK ARTS CENTRE: summer course form
Course: ______ painting

why.en: Leo wanted portrait painting, but it "is already full"; the father says "Let's go for landscape painting".
why.uz: Leo portret rassomligini xohlagan, lekin u «is already full»; ota «Let’s go for landscape painting» deydi.
why.ru: Лео хотел портретную живопись, но она «is already full»; отец выбирает: «Let's go for landscape painting».

stem.en:
WESTBROOK ARTS CENTRE: summer course form
Allergic to: ______

why.en: "Yes, peanuts. He's allergic to peanuts." The word is plural on the form: peanuts.
why.uz: «Yes, peanuts. He’s allergic to peanuts». Anketada koʻplikda yoziladi: peanuts.
why.ru: «Yes, peanuts. He's allergic to peanuts». В анкете — во множественном числе: peanuts.

stem.en:
Course details
• Fee for the week: £______ (materials included)

why.en: "The fee for the week is ninety-five pounds. That includes all the materials." Fifteen was the old extra cost.
why.uz: «The fee for the week is ninety-five pounds. That includes all the materials». 15 — avvalgi qoʻshimcha narx.
why.ru: «The fee for the week is ninety-five pounds. That includes all the materials». 15 — прежняя доплата.

why.en: "There's no café, so he'll need to bring a packed lunch." Only fruit and water are given.

why.ru: «There's no café, so he'll need to bring a packed lunch». Дают только фрукты и воду.

stem.en: Where will the summer classes take place?

options.en: In the old school on Bell Street
In the main building on the high street
In a new school on the high street

why.en: "Not in our main building on the high street. This summer they're in the old school on Bell Street."
why.uz: Asosiy binoda emas: «This summer they’re in the old school on Bell Street». Kafe umuman yoʻq.
why.ru: Не в главном здании: «This summer they're in the old school on Bell Street». Кафе там нет вовсе.

stem.en:
Course details
• Last day: parents are invited to an ______ at 4 pm

why.en: "Parents are invited to an exhibition of the children's work, at four o'clock." Only one word fits after "an".
why.uz: Soat 16:00 da ota-onalar bolalar ishlari koʻrgazmasiga taklif qilinadi: «an exhibition of the children’s work».
why.ru: В 16:00 родителей приглашают на выставку детских работ: «an exhibition of the children's work».

stem.en: What time do the classes start this term?

why.en: "Classes used to start at half past six, but this term it's seven o'clock." Half past six was before.
why.uz: Avval soat 6.30 da boshlanardi, bu semestrda esa soat 7.00 da: «but this term it’s seven».
why.ru: «Classes used to start at half past six, but this term it's seven o'clock». 6.30 — прежнее время.

stem.en:
Fee per term | Who pays it
£______      | the caller (she works)
£180         | students

why.en: Students pay a hundred and eighty, but she works: "Then it's the full price", "two hundred pounds".
why.uz: Talabalar 180 toʻlaydi, lekin u ishlaydi: «Then it’s the full price» — «two hundred pounds».
why.ru: Студенты платят 180, но она работает: «Then it's the full price» — «two hundred pounds».

stem.en:
What to bring
• The college gives the course book.
• Bring a ______ to every class.

why.en: "The college gives you the course book. But please bring a dictionary to every class."
why.uz: Darslikni kollej beradi; har bir darsga lugʻat olib keling: «please bring a dictionary to every class».
why.ru: Учебник даёт колледж, а словарь нужно приносить: «please bring a dictionary to every class».
